o: In Yellowjackets Season 4, rescue draws closer to the teens’ wilderness location, but the survivors’ long-awaited salvation threatens to expose their darkest secrets. In the present-day timeline, an old flame has a homecoming of her own, returning to town with a hidden agenda. Happy returns? Not in the Yellowjackets’ world.

v.n: The Wilderness rewards you 4 your devotion.

eps.o: Everyone comes home. Not everyone comes back. That's what the therapists are gonna tell you, anyway. Tonight, the team faces an inquisition sooner than they ever imagined.

Here we see that Natalie's return from walking in the spiderwebs isn't the salvation it once seemed, especially for Shauna. With new neighbors, a change in leadership, and the pressures of society all bearing down, you better light your candles.

Ate already? Good, because the official '96 Yellowjackets memorial service is now in session. Elsewhen, Tai learns the importance of physical media, and Callie finds it hard to keep rockin' when her crystal ball ain't so crystal clear.

You better bring your a-game tonight, because DJ Nietzsche is in the house at Wiskayok's most existential karaoke joint. Meanwhile, Misty attends a dinner party, and Natalie tries walking a straighter edge.

The Yellowjackets return to high school and learn to put the 'u' in 'trauma.' Gen worries that the gods will not save them. Misty tries making friends and winning hearts while Geraldine comes along for a ride to re-up on the connect.
